name: Gosper Flowsnake
desc: The hexagonal Gosper flowsnake draws itself as one continuous glowing thread with a spectrum gradient running along its arclength, a comet-head sweeping the self-similar snowflake lattice while the whole figure slowly rotates and its recursion depth breathes; renders as spectral snake, electric neon filament, hammered gold-leaf, cyan blueprint schematic, or dry-brush sumi ink.

density.doc: flowsnake recursion depth / lattice fineness (higher = deeper Gosper order, denser weave)

scale.doc: figure size vs frame (higher = fills / overspills frame)

warp.doc: undulation / breathing amplitude of the lattice

hue.doc: base hue anchor (spectral gradient starts here)

seed.doc: deterministic variation (hue offset, rotation dir, orientation, chirality)
